slides.title: Sportmetryx Football
slides.body: Human Performance Intelligence for Football — decision support, validity-gated, explainable, governance-aware.

slides.title: The problem
body: Readiness, workload, recovery, and environment signals reviewed separately.
Exceptions surface late.
Data quality issues discovered after they affect decisions.
Consent and governance hard to demonstrate.
Spreadsheets and gut feel still drive many decisions.

slides.title: What Sportmetryx Football does
body: One operational platform for performance staff.
Exception-first Team Command view.
Validity-gated performance index — numbers only shown when evidence supports them.
Role-based access and team scoping.
Consent and audit visibility.
Data-quality surface.
Marketplace for data products.

slides.title: Scores are honest by design
body: Bands: READY / MONITOR / COMPROMISED / WITHHELD.
Confidence is evidence quality, not probability.
Withheld scores carry a reason code.
Validity gates: consent, calibration, sample integrity, baseline sufficiency, freshness.

slides.title: Business value — operations
body: Faster routing of attention to athletes who need review.
Single exception-first surface instead of hunting across sources.
Readiness distribution, critical/high exceptions, position summaries.
Easy links to roster, player 360, interventions, exports.

slides.title: Business value — trust and governance
body: Validity-gated scores reduce reckless use of weak evidence.
Explainability: components, drivers, checks, reasons.
Role-based access and consent state gate what people can see.
Audit trail is tamper-evident and visible.
Consent can withhold scores and exclude data from exports/cohorts.

slides.title: Business value — data quality and marketplace
body: Data quality shown as a first-class surface: invalid samples, calibration, import jobs, staleness, withheld scores.
Marketplace turns datasets and import jobs into data products.
Products are browsable, shortlistable, comparable, previewable.
Makes the platform a data-products surface, not just a dashboard.

slides.title: Key insights
body: Baseline-first is different from population-first.
Validity should be explicit, not implicit.
Confidence is not probability.
Exceptions are the right organizing principle for operations.
Governance and consent belong in the product, not as an afterthought.
Data products need metadata: source, size, availability, tag, what's included.

slides.title: What was built
body: Landing + guest mode + authenticated app shell.
Team Command, Roster, Position Room, Practice Command, Game Readiness, Recovery Command, Environment & Travel.
Data Quality, Research & Exports, Administration & Audit.
Player 360, Digital Athlete Twin, Governance & Consent.
Seven-component index, validity gates, confidence, drivers, withheld reason codes.
Session auth, server-enforced RBAC, athlete access control, consent + audit.
Validated CSV import, import jobs, CSV exports, de-identified export option.
Marketplace: catalog, search, filters, sort, shortlist, detail, sample preview, demo cart/checkout, shortlist preview + comparison.

slides.title: What was learned
body: Honesty labels are not optional — withheld results must be obvious and explained.
Deployment failures are often environment/secret/bundling issues, not product bugs.
Exception-first surfaces are easier to act on than flat lists.
Governance becomes more credible when visible, not buried.
Data products need strong metadata to feel real.

slides.title: Limitations and next steps
body: Prototype weights and thresholds.
Synthetic sample data for demo/guest modes.
No live external data feeds.
Demo checkout only — no real payment processing.
Deployment depends on correct database and secret configuration on the host.
Next steps: review configuration, add more import sources, strengthen exports, expand marketplace metadata and comparison.

slides.title: Summary
slides.body: Sportmetryx Football is a decision-support platform that makes performance intelligence operational, explainable, validity-gated, and governance-aware — with a marketplace layer that turns data into reusable products.
